title: Trajectory Density Ratios under Weak Support: A Survey across the Sciences
abstract: arXiv:2611.11985v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many problems across the sciences compare two stochastic processes through the sequences they generate. Reinforcement learning asks what a new policy would return from the trajectories of an old one; molecular simulation asks how much more a ligand binds from samples of the unbound state; climate attribution asks how a heat wave shifted under warming; and language-model post-training asks what a deployed agent will do from logged interactions. In every case, one quantity would answer all these questions at once: the ratio of the two probability laws over their generated sequences, the trajectory density ratio. This ratio exists only under strong conditions. When one process reaches states the other cannot, the ratio does not exist; when their overlap is thin, its variance grows without control with the sequence length; and when they concentrate on different lower-dimensional sets, the ratio is undefined altogether. Weak support

translated_title: 弱支持下的轨迹密度比：跨科学的综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.11985v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：科学领域的许多问题需要通过两个随机过程生成的序列来对它们进行比较。强化学习问的是：从旧策略的轨迹出发，一个新策略会带来怎样的回报；分子模拟问的是：从未结合态的样本出发，配体的结合能力提高了多少；气候归因问的是：在变暖背景下，一场热浪发生了怎样的偏移；语言模型后训练问的是：从记录下来的交互数据出发，部署后的智能体会做出什么行为。在所有这些情形中，有一个量可以同时回答上述所有问题：两个概率规律在其生成序列上的比值，即轨迹密度比。这个比值只在很强的条件下才存在。当一个过程到达了另一个过程无法到达的状态时，该比值不存在；当两者的重叠区域很薄时，其方差会随序列长度不受控制地增长；而当两者集中于不同的低维集合上时，该比值则完全无定义。弱支持（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文是一篇跨学科综述，系统梳理了轨迹密度比这一统一量在强化学习、分子模拟、气候归因和语言模型后训练等领域的核心作用，并分析了其在支撑薄弱（弱支持）情形下的存在性条件、方差爆炸与无定义等根本性失效问题。
en_tdlr: This survey unifies trajectory density ratios across the sciences—from reinforcement learning and molecular simulation to climate attribution and language-model post-training—clarifying when such ratios exist and how they break down under weak support.
